evals.prompt: Can you review this PR before I merge it? It's a ~150 line change adding a discount calculation function to our checkout service.
evals.expected_output: A five-axis review (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance) with severity-labeled findings and an explicit approve/request-changes verdict.
expectations: Review explicitly covers all five axes: correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance
Findings are labeled with severity (e.g. Critical/Nit/Optional) so required vs optional is clear
Checks whether tests exist and cover edge cases, not just that tests pass
Ends with an explicit verdict: approve or request changes
Does not rubber-stamp with an unsupported 'LGTM'
